26 pp, 43 sections.

**Abstract.** We consider a family of linear operators diagonalized by the Hankel transform. We express explicitly the Fredholm determinants of these operators, as restricted to L2[0, R], so that the rate of their conver- gence as R →∞can be found. We use the link between these determinants and the distribution of additive functionals in a determinantal point process with Bessel kernel and estimate the distance in the Kolmogorov–Smirnov metric between the distribution of these functionals and the Gaussian dis- tribution.
